target_scope: One publisher-selected reported 2025 HQ point per covered firm; not all offices or all co-HQs
independent_information: 498 designated HQ assignments; 50 metro feature profiles. Repeated rows are not independent regional experiments.

baseline.descriptive: Observed company-HQ counts and sector breakdowns; same covered498 roster as metro track
baseline.prediction: Share the metro employment-proportional baseline: estimate total HQs/private-job rate inside each training fold. Per-company probability is predicted metro count/498; flag any out-of-range probability rather than silently clipping.
baseline.secondary: Training-fold pooled company-MSA event rate; sum498 probabilities to recover the fold mean metro count
baseline.fair_comparison: Baseline deliberately adds no company-specific information; detailed models must improve on it

regression.features: Main effects plus four frozen sector-ecosystem interactions
regression.processing: Fit numeric imputation/missing indicators, scaling, and one-hot encoding on training rows only; retain encoder for held-out MSAs

conservative_ml.features: Same primary predictors; fold-fitted category encoding
conservative_ml.starting_search: Depth1-2, strong penalties, small predeclared tuning grid; no reliance on large nominal row count

aggregation.expected_hqs: Sum predicted probabilities across the same498 firms in each held-out MSA
aggregation.threshold: Do not threshold probabilities at0.5 before aggregation
aggregation.uncertainty: Account for shared metro and company dependence; do not assume independent Bernoulli errors
aggregation.coherence: Marginal probabilities, not a constrained joint HQ-location choice model. Do not force probabilities to sum to1 per firm over this incomplete50-MSA frame.

validation.main: Reuse identical whole-MSA development folds as aggregate track; all498 Atlanta rows excluded from all fitting, preprocessing, calibration, and selection
validation.company_scope: Known covered roster in a new MSA; new-company generalization needs a separate company-held-out experiment
validation.tuning: Nested or prespecified within development only; a final Atlanta result must not select between tracks
metro_metrics: Poisson deviance of summed expected counts
company_metrics: Calibration; accuracy alone is uninformative at this base rate
validation.prevalence: Keep all real HQ negatives; no default class rebalancing, negative undersampling, or scale_pos_weight. Such changes distort sum-ready probabilities unless corrected/calibrated within training only.

leakage_prohibitions: Company or metro IDs as free predictors
collection: Full-500 extension from cited publisher sources and retained metro inputs; supplemental source checks are not independent historical HQ verification. Coverage exclusions remain explicit.
